notes: Item 7 targeted excerpt was empty. The 10-K points readers to the 2024 Sustainability Report for sustainability work, but Item 1 itself describes specific community activities and has a human capital discussion well over 150 words, so Community and Cross-cultural coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. Global access to affordable medicines, including ARVs supplied in more than 100 countries, was treated as international sales and the core pharma business, not cross-cultural customer access. Patient 'educational seminars' and healthcare professional education were not counted: they are described only generally and resemble customer education, which is a trap. The Elevate wellbeing program and Champions network were not counted toward any theme. A planned restructuring with up to about 10% global workforce reduction was announced in February 2026. Values-screen only: this does not override the financial plan's priority of funding the 2033-2042 payments.
